fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Gross Sales plus a discretionary Surcharge of up to $10/week (currently only applied in New York). Royalty may increase to up to 15% during breach/default periods. Advertising Fee is 2.5% of weekly Gross Sales for traditional locations (1.5% to National Fund, 1% to Regional Fund); 1% for non-traditional locations (all to National Fund). Advertising Fee may be increased up to 3% of weekly Gross Sales with 30 days notice. POS Help Desk Phone Support Maintenance Contract Fee is $55/month (not charged if franchisee uses NCR POS System). sweetFrog Loyalty Program fee is $45/month per store for first POS and $20/month for each additional POS. Data Fees up to $100/month (currently not charged). Gift Card Redemption Fee $0.07 per activity; Gift Card Fee $0.05 per Read/Balance Inquiry/Reload; Gift Card Location Fee $6/month. Management Fee of 6% of Gross Sales (in addition to Royalty and Advertising Fees) applies only if franchisor assumes management of the business.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee and Surcharge (Notes 1 and 13): 5% of Gross Sales plus a maximum Surcharge of $10 per week (Note 2) | Withdrawn electronically from your Depository Account weekly (Note 3) | "Gross Sales" include all revenue from your Franchised Business excluding sales tax and authorized refunds, credits and allowances.
Advertising Fee (traditional Franchised Business) (Note 1): 2.5% of weekly Gross Sales | Same as Royalty Fee (Note 3) | The Advertising Fee is deposited as follows: 1.5% to the National Fund and 1% to the Regional Fund for your Cooperative or your Franchised Business (Note 4).
Advertising Fee (non-traditional Franchised Business) (Note 1): 1% of weekly Gross Sales | Same as Royalty Fee (Note 3) | The Advertising Fee is deposited as follows: 1% to the National Fund (Note 4).
POS Help Desk Phone Support Maintenance Contract Fee (if applicable see Note 15): $55 per month | Last Thursday of each month | We will debit your Depository Account for this fee.
sweetFrog Loyalty Program: $45 per store for first POS and $20 per month for each additional POS | Monthly | You must participate in the Loyalty Program.
Data Fees (Notes 1 and 7): Up to $100 per month (subject to reasonable annual and/or service enhancement increases) | Same as Royalty Fee (Note 3) | Begins immediately after you open your Franchised Business.
Gift Card Redemption Fee: $0.07 per activity (Note 14) | Weekly | Fee is charged by us and collected by a third party on our behalf.
Gift Card Fee: $0.05 per Red/Balance Inquiry/Reload | Weekly | Fee is charged by us and collected by a third party on our behalf.
Gift Card Location Fee: $6 monthly | On or about the 2nd day of each month | Fee is charged by us and collected by a third party on our behalf.
Management Fee: 6% of the Franchised Business' Gross Sales (in addition to the Royalty Fee and Advertising Fee) plus our direct out-of-pocket costs and expenses | Payable with Royalty and Advertising Fee | If we assume the management of your Franchised Business for any period of time.
